title: runtime/cli: the explicit sqlite / sqlite-wasm refusal tells an operator who set OS_DATABASE_DRIVER to "set OS_DATABASE_DRIVER explicitly"
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): a refusal's remedy that does not fit the operator who reads it. It comes from #23863's dev (`os-dev-report` `6215053592` on #23863, out-of-scope finding 1, PR #23896 head `c80f0ceaa`).

`reach:` measured at the public door on that head: `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite OS_DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5999/db os serve --dev` exits 1 with

```
[StandaloneStack] sqlite driver was selected but the URL does not look like a file path (its scheme is "jdbc:"). Use file:/path/to/db.sqlite, or set OS_DATABASE_DRIVER explicitly.
```

The operator did set `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER` explicitly: that is why this refusal fired. The CLI host's legacy `os serve` path prints the same sentence, untagged, as `UnsupportedDriverError`.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## Where

`sqliteFilenameFromUrl` in `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts` builds the sentence. It reaches the operator only under an explicit `sqlite` / `sqlite-wasm` selection (`OS_DATABASE_DRIVER`, `--database-driver`, the `databaseDriver` option), because the URL classification never hands it a value with a scheme. The second remedy was written when the `sqlite` kind was the only one refusing; PR #23896 (#23863) widens the same sentence to the `sqlite-wasm` kind, and its ruling kept the `sqlite` kind's words unchanged, so the remedy was not touched there.

## Done looks like

The remedy names what the operator can actually change: a `file:` path for the SQLite kind they selected, or a driver that matches the URL (unset `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER` so the URL selects it, or set it to the URL's driver). Both hosts keep one sentence (`driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts` holds them equal), and it still names the scheme only, never the URL.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `sqlite driver was selected but the URL does not look like a file path set OS_DATABASE_DRIVER explicitly` → 12 hits. The family is #23633, #23765, #23794 and #23863 (this card's parent PR); #19976, #23573, #9053 and #9075 are neighbours. None names this remedy sentence.

Dedupe words: sqlite driver was selected remedy set OS_DATABASE_DRIVER explicitly; explicit driver refusal advice; sqliteFilenameFromUrl refusal wording.
